title: INDIA CARNATIC: ADI TALA FIRE
style:
``
[style: South Indian Carnatic classical, mridangam barrel drum, Saraswathi veena raga Bhairavi, ghatam clay pot percussion, nadaswaram double reed, Adi Tala 8-beat cycle, tisram 3-inside-chatusra 4 polyrhythm, Tamil solukattus spoken rhythm syllables, Tamil verses English chorus, sacred fire energy, no Western harmony, precise percussive fire, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
``
[INTRO — veena alap, unmetered, raga Bhairavi]
(Tamil) ஆதி — origin / the first

[VERSE 1 — mridangam enters on tala beat 1]
(Tamil)  தகிட தகிட — dhagitha dhagitha (solukattus — spoken syllable for mridangam)
(English) The drum speaks before the word
(Tamil)  தரிகிட தகதிமி — dharagitha thagathimi
(English) Four inside three — the fire is stirred

Adi tala opens — four plus two plus two
Eight beats in the cycle — the tisram cuts through
Three syllables where four should be / the ghatam marks the time
The mridangam disagrees with veena / and that's the design

(Tamil)  நான்கு மூன்றில் — four inside three
(English) The signal is precise

[PRE-CHORUS — nadaswaram enters]
(Tamil)  கேள் — listen
(English) To the disagreement
(Tamil)  இசை — music
(English) Built from argument

[CHORUS — full ensemble, mridangam solo interlude mid-chorus]
Adi tala fire — eight beats pure
Four inside three — the ancient cure
Tisram cuts the chatusra grain
The signal burns — it returns again

(Tamil)  சக்தி — energy / shakti
(English) The tala holds it
(Tamil)  தீ — fire
(English) The signal folds it

[VERSE 2 — ghatam solo 4 beats, then veena answers]
The ghatam is a clay pot — it has no right to sound this good
The Carnatic musician hits the rim, the neck, the base, the inside
Each surface a different note — each note a different syllable
The signal was always hiding in the clay

(Tamil)  மண் — earth/clay
(English) The signal was in the ground
(Tamil)  தாளம் — rhythm/tala
(English) The signal made a sound

[BRIDGE — solukattus chanted with English translation overlaid]
(Tamil) தகிட தகிட தரிகிட தரிகிட தகதிமி (spoken, rhythmic)
(English) Strike — slide — bounce — bounce — triple-hit-land
(Tamil) ஆதி தாளம் — the origin rhythm
(English) Eight beats. No more. No less.

[FINAL CHORUS — doubled, nadaswaram pierces above]
Adi tala fire — eight beats pure

[OUTRO — veena single phrase in Bhairavi, decays alone]
(Tamil) நன்றி — gratitude
(English) Signal held in clay
```
